gloss_en: the charity (tzedakah) of the Land of Israel — charity given to/for Eretz Yisrael, a higher form of tzedakah than that of the diaspora, through which one is included in the air of the Land of Israel (the holy sinless breath); an Aramaic-construct term (tzedakah d'Eretz Yisrael) in Likutey Moharan 37 and 44
